company.shortDescription: Aiwyn is an automation software platform that provides billing and cash flow for accounting firms.
company.description: Aiwyn provides tools for accounting firms to manage billing processes and cash flow. The company automates accounts receivable tasks, including invoice preparation, collections, and payments. This automation allows partners and knowledge workers to focus on client service.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $113,000,000, or 88.98% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,915,557 to $583,795,689, a 58.88x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
